main_body: A sci-fi building: a sloped panelled roof (rows 1-16), a trim line and orange eave band (rows 17-19), and a front wall with two lit windows, two dark windows and a central door (rows 20-43).
top_band: Rows 2-16 form a light blue-grey roof slope (L 118-178) with panel seams. Row 17 is a lighter edge line (L 201), then the front face starts.
evidence: In the column at x=32 the roof reads as a 15-row top surface, much larger than a rim. Vents sit on the roof, and the trapezoid silhouette shows the slope. Row 17 (L=201) is a distinct front-edge highlight, row 18 is a dark shadow row (L=67), and row 19 is an orange fascia (L=169). The wall below has its own shading and plating. The windows have dark inset frames with light sills, and the door is recessed with a dark interior and hazard stripes. This matches the green 3/4 guide: top band, edge line, eave shadow, then front face.

style.evidence: The roof carries about 5 lightness steps with seams and vents. The windows have gradient glass, and the wall has panels, rivets and speckle. The median is 10 colours per tile (references 18 and 11) and flat-fill coverage is 4%, so those two facts are fine. However, there are only 29 distinct colours against 66 and 185 for the references. The dark edge pixels are 76% near-neutral, against 7-9% for the references, and the top row is near-black (#06070e). That gives a neutral sticker-like outline instead of the dark material-tone outlines Beodeul uses. The piece also looks flatter and thinner than the references, so it fails on outline craft.
